feature_title: Logs Search Bar Stream Not Found Error

rationale.edition: All changed paths are open-source locations: web/src/plugins/logs/*.vue, web/src/locales/languages/*.json, and scripts/translations/.translation_state.json. None live under enterprise-owned directories (o2_enterprise/, enterprise/, src/enterprise/), and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR) appear in any changed path or symbol, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing: it alters the logs search bar behavior so a SQL query naming a non-existent stream now shows a specific 'Stream does not exist' message instead of falling back to the generic empty state. trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty, so no explicit opt-out marker or skip label is present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change adds a user-exercisable UI flow in web/src/plugins/logs: a user types a SQL query referencing a missing stream, and the UI must surface a specific error message rather than the generic 'pick a stream' prompt (SearchBar.vue sets filterErrMsg, Index.vue now gates the empty-state on filterErrMsg being empty, IndexList.vue clears it on stream selection). This interaction needs browser verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of the change lives in web/src/plugins/logs/ (SearchBar.vue, Index.vue, IndexList.vue), which is the Logs product area. The corresponding Playwright area folder is tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/.
rationale.group: The enterprise overlay ci_matrix.ent.json references two OSS Logs shards, 'Logs-Core' (jobSearch.spec.js) and 'Logs-Features' (searchPatterns.spec.js). A stream-not-found message in the main search bar is core search behavior, so the closest existing group is 'Logs-Core'.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file added is web/src/plugins/logs/SearchBar.streamNotFound.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test, not a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so it does not count as existing E2E coverage.
